title: Dark Imperium
author: guy-haley
description: A hundred years have passed since Roboute Guilliman returned from stasis to take command of the Imperium. Now the resurrected primarch leads his Indomitus Crusade, but the shadow of his long-lost brother Mortarion falls across Ultramar as the Death Guard emerge from the warp to finish what the Horus Heresy began.

title: Plague War
author: guy-haley
description: Mortarion has come to Ultramar with a host of plague legionaries, intent on transforming Guilliman's realm into a new Garden of Nurgle. The war for Ultramar reaches its bloody zenith as brother faces brother — and Guilliman must confront the terrible truth of what his traitor kin have become.

title: Godblight
author: guy-haley
description: The climax of the Plague War. Guilliman and Mortarion stand at the brink of a confrontation ten thousand years in the making, while Nurgle himself takes an interest in the outcome. Gods walk the mortal plane as the fate of Ultramar — and Guilliman's soul — hangs in the balance.
